# Lox meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: LoxMeat | Source: Lox | Usage: Cooking, Taming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Lox meat is a basic food obtained by killing Lox. It can be cooked directly on an Iron cooking station, but not on a wooden Cooking station, to obtain Cooked lox meat, or Coal if overcooked. It is used directly in food recipes at the Food preparation table.

## Availability

• Creature: Lox | 0 Star: 4-5

### Crafting

• Cooked lox meat
• Coal, if left on an Iron cooking station for too long
• Lox meat pie (from Unbaked lox pie)
• Meat platter (from Uncooked meat platter)
Cooked lox meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Lox meat as ingredient.

Categorias: Materials, Food
